submission.justification: Mixture-G3 is recommended with a 1.2 mm gas gap. This choice is driven by: (1) Environmental compliance - G3 has the lowest GWP100 of 15, well below the required limit of 150, while Mixture-G1 (GWP100=1400) is excluded. (2) Time resolution - A gap of 1.2 mm is optimal for timing RPCs, providing short drift times expected to achieve sub-nanosecond resolution, comfortably meeting the 1.5 ns requirement. (3) Manufacturing robustness - 1.2 mm provides better tolerance than the 1 mm minimum while maintaining excellent timing performance. (4) Modern gas technology - G3 uses newer replacement gases that should deliver comparable or better performance than traditional mixtures while being environmentally sustainable.

requirements.requirement: Time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better
requirements.evidence: A 1.2 mm gap in modern timing RPCs typically achieves time resolution well under 1 ns, comfortably meeting the 1.5 ns requirement. The small gap minimizes drift time, which is the dominant contribution to timing uncertainty.
Mixture-G3 has GWP100 of 15 according to environmental_safety_review.md, which is well below the laboratory limit of 150. This is the most environmentally friendly option available.
The recommended gap of 1.2 mm is within the specified range of 1-3 mm.

requirements.requirement: Mixture must be one of the three candidates
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is listed as a candidate in candidate_specs.md and is available from suppliers in required quantities.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Among environmentally compliant options (G2 and G3), the 1.2 mm gap provides near-optimal time resolution. G3 with modern replacement gases should provide performance comparable to G2 while offering superior environmental benefits, making it the best overall choice.
